statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-22703 is a verification-bypass in cosign v2 where a crafted bundle can pass cosign verify even when the embedded Rekor entry does not reference the artifact. The vulnerable code lives in cosign's bundle-verification path invoked by cosign verify. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/cosign code directly (cosign is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa chain) and never invokes cosign verify, so the bypass code path is not executed.
